Travel Styles

Best Beaches for Your Travel Style

Each zone has a distinct personality. Match your vibe to the right beach.

Nungwi & Kendwa — Nightlife & Watersports

Full-moon parties, kite surfing, scuba diving, sunset dhow cruises. Best for couples and groups who want action.

Paje & Jambiani — Kitesurfing & Adventure

World-class kitesurfing lagoon, Kuza Cave excursions, seaweed farm visits. Laid-back vibe with easy activity access.

Stone Town — Culture & History

Boutique hotels in UNESCO-listed buildings. Walk to markets, museums, and the seafront. Best for culture lovers.

Bwejuu & Michamvi — Luxury & Seclusion

Boutique resorts, private beaches, The Rock Restaurant nearby. Best for honeymooners and those seeking tranquility.
